fix(codeon): recover Cursor terminal-without-completion without operator_cancel

retry_agent_failure_if_recoverable only adopted Codex idle-without-completion
evidence. Cursor/Grok terminal-without-completion exhausted MAX=3 into
ResultInvalid + operator_cancel, then startup returned attempt_not_ready
because the matcher was Codex-only and live-session preflight blocked a
dead Cursor session.

Treat the published Cursor/Grok/fake terminal-without-completion strings as
recoverable, skip live-session preflight for that class, and promote a
fresh fenced dispatch the same way Codex already does.
